mapper.sql: template_id, shop_id, name, free_threshold, status, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, is_deleted
mapper.select: SELECT FROM freight_template WHERE shop_id = #{shopId} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT rule_id, template_id, region_code, min_amount, fee, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted FROM freight_rule WHERE template_id = #{templateId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY region_code ASC, min_amount ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO freight_template(template_id, shop_id, name, free_threshold, status, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, is_deleted) VALUES (#{templateId}, #{shopId}, #{name}, #{freeThreshold}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE freight_template SET name = #{name}, free_threshold = #{freeThreshold}, status = #{status}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE template_id = #{templateId} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE freight_rule SET is_deleted = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE template_id = #{templateId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO freight_rule(rule_id, template_id, region_code, min_amount, fee, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted) VALUES (#{ruleId}, #{templateId}, #{regionCode}, #{minAmount}, #{fee}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, 0)
